9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player so each new episode is delivered straight to your ears as soon as it's released.

Stories covered on this episode:

  • Apple Maps changes 'Lake Ontario' to 'Lake America' in response to Trump's executive order
  • Apple executive shake-up continues as Ternus takes over as CEO
  • A look at the compensation for John Ternus as CEO and Tim Cook as Executive Chairman
  • Read the full internal memo John Ternus sent to Apple employees on his first day in the role
